subject: Defer ordinary RaiseShield posture to stand-up execution
description: Ordinary RaiseShield translation eagerly stamped a lying soldier Upright even though Original first prepends an authored standing-up transition and changes posture only when that order executes. Translation may append RaisingShield, but it no longer applies the immediate Upright/HoldingShield state pair reserved for RaiseShieldInstantly.
